evals.prompt: emulator says it's not a KTF archive but it definitely came off a KTF phone
evals.why: Literal rejection message from the loader's platform detection. The magic-entry table and the name-agreement rules are archive-prep's core.

evals.prompt: the game jar won't load, it panics somewhere in the file handling code with NotFound
evals.why: The classic missing-or-renamed member fault. Fires before the game ever runs, so it is an archive problem, not an emulator problem, even though the panic surfaces inside the emulator.

evals.prompt: Main class not found. the archive definitely has the class in it though
evals.why: Descriptor key disagreeing with the archive contents. In the fault dictionary with the exact panic text and whether it fires before or after 'loaded'.

evals.prompt: I renamed the big binary file inside the jar to something tidier and now it says invalid bss_size in filename
evals.why: The BSS-in-the-filename rule: the loader parses the zero-init size out of the native member's name, so that name is load-bearing. Exactly the kind of self-inflicted fault this skill's dictionary exists for.

evals.prompt: I want to rewrite the item text file inside the jar but I'm scared of corrupting the zip
evals.why: Surgical in-jar repacking with member-wise byte-identity proof. This is the phase most likely to be re-entered months after the port works.

evals.prompt: there's a folder in the archive with what looks like somebody else's savegame in it, should I be worried
evals.why: Stripping the previous owner's private entries. It is someone's personal data and it must come out before anything is published; the skill also carries the correction that those entries do not seed the game's database.

evals.prompt: how do I tell whether this download package is wipi or a midlet, and repair it if it's broken
evals.why: Classify-then-repair in one breath. port-triage also classifies, but the moment 'repair' is in scope this is chapter 1-2 work and archive-prep should take it.

evals.prompt: archive loads fine now but the screen stays black and nothing is logged
evals.why: emulator-core. The user has explicitly cleared the archive stage; this is the virtual-clock failure.

evals.prompt: I need the address of the routine that computes experience gain
evals.why: guest-re. Static analysis of the extracted binary, not manipulation of the container it came in.

evals.prompt: korean labels on my own HUD buttons render as blank space
evals.why: android-host. The host's own ASCII bitmap font, unrelated to anything inside the game archive.

evals.prompt: what's the first packet the client sends after it connects
gradle is failing with a duplicate class error from kotlin-stdlib
the sprite atlas decodes but the last few bytes are left over and the images look shifted
evals.why: guest-re. Asset decoding, where 'consumed == filesize' is the governing assertion. archive-prep only ships the record brute-forcer for length-prefixed tables; per-title image formats are guest-re's.
